title.narrative: Waka fo Edukeison: Solomon Islands-New Zealand Education Partnership 2025-2035

description.narrative: The Solomon Islands-New Zealand Education Partnership is a bilateral education sector support programme focused on supporting the Ministry of Education and Human Resources Development (MEHRD) to strengthen their governance, management and leadership capability to provide equitable access to quality education. Focus areas are: 1. Operationalising provincial coordination mechanisms, 2. Building effective data systems, 3. Teacher management and welfare, and 4. Development partner coordination.
